integrated-pest-management-threshold.alt: Line graph, invented data for practice. Average aphids per leaf, counted each week: 2, 3, 5, 8, 12, 6, 4, 5, 7 and 9 for weeks 1 to 10. A dashed line marks the action threshold at 10 aphids per leaf. The count passes the threshold only in week 5 (12 aphids per leaf); a targeted control is used then, and the count falls to 6 the next week and stays below the threshold.
